ios.desc:
Photo Video Maker With Music app helps you to create Image Slideshow from your mobile in seconds, along with music. Also included functionality is of Story Maker and Video Editor. Create beautiful Music Slideshow and share with friends and family for best occasions in life. Photo video maker with music, lets you select collections of photos or images and convert these images into video.

Also you can add background music.

Story Maker: 
Dive into the world of endless storytelling possibilities with our Story Maker functionality. Whether you're crafting epic adventures, heartfelt tales, or whimsical fantasies, this app is your ultimate creative companion. Choose from a variety of templates, characters, and settings, or let your imagination run wild with a blank canvas. Perfect for writers, dreamers, and anyone with a story to tell—Story Maker brings your ideas to life with ease and fun!

Video Editor:
Create Stunning Videos with Ease! Transform your moments into masterpieces with our Video Editor functionality. Whether you're trimming clips, adding effects, or syncing music, this app has all the tools you need to craft professional-quality videos. Intuitive controls, creative filters, and seamless exporting make editing a breeze. Perfect for beginners and pros alike—unleash your creativity and tell your story, one frame at a time!
Easy to share as well.
